meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文案或设计稿转成动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要快速产出宣传或解说类动画,而不想逐帧手工制作。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a brief or design into an animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce promo or explainer animations without frame-by-frame manual work.

howto.what: 当你要做、改或渲染任何视频/动画时,Claude会先调用统一入口:读取已有项目文件或空白状态,必要时询问视频主题,再按规则选定相应制作流程,最后用HyperFrames(把HTML变成视频的技术)生成可播放的视频动画成果。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画或动态图形的请求,或需要处理已有HyperFrames项目时,此技能作为入口被触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇说明文做成一段60秒解说视频。
say.note: 会先询问要点,再走解说视频流程。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加字幕,不要改动画面。
say.note: 只叠加字幕,不改动原画面。

say.text: 把公司网站主页做成宣传动画。
say.note: 会依据网站内容生成宣传片。

howto.what_en: On any request to create, edit or render a video or animation, Claude enters a single entry point: it checks existing project files or blank start, asks the topic if needed, selects the matching workflow, and finally renders playable video via HyperFrames (an HTML-to-video tool).
howto.when_en: Triggered by any request to make, modify or render a video/animation/motion-graphic, or to handle an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a 60-second narrated explainer.
say_en.note: It runs the explainer flow after clarifying points.

say_en.text: Add captions to this interview clip without altering the footage.
say_en.note: It overlays captions only, leaving footage as-is.

say_en.text: Make a promo animation from our company website homepage.
say_en.note: It generates a promo based on the site's content.
